title: The Telangana Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages Act, 1953.
full_text: The Telangana Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages Act, 1953. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19538 Act Number: 8 Enactment Date: 1953-04-24 Act Year: 1953 Short Title: The Telangana Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages Act, 1953. Long Title: An Act to provide for the appointment of a Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages and for matters connected therewith. Department: Department of Revenue Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Establishment of a general Registry Office and appointment of Registrar General and sending certified copies of entries of births and deaths to that Office. Section 3. Indexes to be kept at the general Registry Office. Section 4. Index to be open to Inspection. Section 5. Copies of entries to be admissible in evidence. Section 6. Superintendence of Registrars by Registrar General. Section 7. Savings. Section 8. Power to make rules.
